posts.body: Now I understand better. I saw the RPG Maker MV screenshot and thought you wanted to recreate the same mechanic in MZ. Adding to Att_Turan's suggestion, you’ll also need to handle the return to the original graphics at the end of the battle or when the transformation duration expires
